# Closet - Full Content

> Private, self-hosted household wardrobe organizer. Catalog garments with photos, build outfits, schedule them on a calendar, and share a wardrobe between users.

## Overview

Closet is a self-hosted fork of Libre Closet, licensed under the AGPL-3.0. It is a server-rendered progressive web app intended to be installed on a phone and used by a household. All data stays in a PostgreSQL database on the host that runs it.

## Features

### Garment catalog
Each garment has a photo, category, brand, size, colors, washing details, acquisition date and notes. Photos have their background removed on upload and are stored as optimized WebP. Categories are customizable and filterable.

### Outfit builder
Combine garments into saved outfits with a visual builder.

### Outfit calendar
Schedule outfits on a calendar to plan the week and see what has been worn.

### Wardrobe sharing
Share a wardrobe with another user through an invite link, with view-only or edit permission.

### Offline-tolerant PWA
Installs to the home screen and renders cached reads without a connection. Web Push notifications are supported when VAPID keys are configured.

### Multilingual
English, Italian, French, Russian, German and Spanish.

## Routes

- /wardrobe - garment catalog (the root path redirects here)
- /outfits - saved outfits and the outfit builder
- /calendar - outfit schedule
- /about - about and license attribution
- /auth/login - sign in (when authentication is enabled)

## Self-hosting

```bash
docker run -d \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -v closet_data:/app/data \
  ghcr.io/agandhi4/closet:latest
```

See the README for docker-compose and environment variable options.

## Tech Stack

- **License:** AGPL-3.0
- **Backend:** NestJS on Fastify (TypeScript), Handlebars templates
- **Frontend:** htmx + hyperscript, Tailwind + daisyUI (server-rendered, no client framework)
- **Database:** PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM)
- **Images:** client-side background removal (ONNX runtime), sharp for WebP
- **Offline:** Workbox service worker, Web Push
- **Storage:** local disk
- **Auth:** optional JWT cookie authentication
- **Deploy:** Docker image on GHCR
